summary.text: Gold dragonfish, also called golden dragonfish, sit at the top of Fang Yuan's modified dragonfish line. The one his clone finds in dragon scale sea area is an ancient desolate beast and the king of his dragonfish stock.

claims.text: In dragon scale sea area, Fang Yuan’s clone finds a dragonfish shining like gold, with densely packed golden scales and sharper eyes than ordinary stock. It is the smallest of the group, not even the size of a person’s palm, yet it holds only food path dao marks and no other path’s dao marks. Small as it is, it gives off the aura of a true ancient desolate beast. Other dragonfish can reach desolate beast at most, but the golden dragonfish can become ancient desolate beast, which Fang Yuan reads as the limit of the species’ development.

The golden dragonfish rules the wider dragonfish group as its king: once it appears, every lower dragonfish species, ordinary, desolate beast, copper, iron, and silver, moves around it and defends and follows it. Fang Yuan’s clone judges his own control over the stock as lower than the beast’s and expects he would lose a direct contest for that control, yet he still controls the ancient golden dragonfish itself, so the chain of control holds. Dragonfish have no fighting strength, and even the ancient golden dragonfish ranks bottom tier in battle strength among ancient desolate beasts, so the stock serves as goods rather than a combat force. At You Chan’s dragonfish sea area Fang Yuan uses no immortal method, only this beast he controls, and the dragonfish she raised follow him into his immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan’s dragonfish sea area in the sovereign immortal aperture is a giant resource point that can produce copper, iron, silver, and gold dragonfish, and it is his most important source of revenue at that time.

While soul searching Spectral Soul, Fairy Zi Wei holds an iron dragonfish and states that with that portion of the food path true inheritance, Heavenly Court can also produce iron, copper, silver, and gold dragonfish to change the situation in treasure yellow heaven.
Heavenly Court later starts selling silver dragonfish in treasure yellow heaven, which Fang Yuan puts down to Spectral Soul’s method, and he expects golden dragonfish to appear in the market in time.

Golden scale pulled from a desolate beast golden dragonfish goes into a ball of black oil as the second of two immortal materials. Fang Yuan finds the golden dragonfish and black oil have high compatibility when refining gather oil Gu.
